title: Introduce a repository-to-service dependency cycle
description: backend/app/repositories/user.py gains an import of backend/app/services/user.py, closing a cycle between the service and repository layers. The change is entirely internal to the backend: no contract, page, or infrastructure component is touched.
notes: The canonical over-inclusion case: ground truth is one component and two validators, while manifest-level impact reaches five components, twenty-one configuration variables, and frontend-test. What the graph adds is the file-level reverse-importer set of the two seeds - every service and route that imports the user repository or service - which is the actual review surface for a layering cycle.
